text_block_list.text:
Mayano Top Gun claimed victory after 
giving it her absolute all. She enjoyed 
her duel with Narita Brian from the bottom 
of her heart, unable to contain her 
excitement.

And Mayano Top Gun, realizing that Narita 
Brian was still not satisfied—

She resolves to run in the Hanshin 
Daishoten to once again enjoy a thrilling 
contest against her.
